name: greenhouse-skills
description: Greenhouse recruiting skills on the Greenhouse MCP connector (open beta)

plugins.name: greenhouse
plugins.description: Recruiter workflows on your Greenhouse data: a daily brief, the week's interviews, candidate status, debriefs with confirm-first notes and stage moves, pipeline and source reviews, draft scorecards from your own notes and an access check, most shown as a page, plus Greenhouse's style on other visuals. Reads respect your Greenhouse permissions; skills preview each write or nudge and wait for your yes, and send nudges only through your own chat or email tool. Greenhouse MCP is in open beta.
